plugins.name: zcode-wakatime
plugins.description: WakaTime plugin for ZCode. Installs wakatime-cli, then records AI coding heartbeats on session start, user prompts, file edits and session end.

description_i18n.en: WakaTime plugin for ZCode. Installs wakatime-cli, then records AI coding heartbeats on session start, user prompts, file edits and session end.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 的 WakaTime 插件：自动安装 wakatime-cli，并在会话启动、用户提交、文件编辑与会话结束时记录 AI 编程心跳。
